shortDescription: Collect facts from remote devices running Free Range Routing (FRR).

options.name: gather_subset
options.description: When supplied, this argument restricts the facts collected to a given subset. Possible values for this argument include C(all), C(hardware), C(config), and C(interfaces). Specify a list of values to include a larger subset. Use a value with an initial C(!) to collect all facts except that subset.
